data.title: Car insurance premium recalculation – additional payment due
data.summary: Kfz-Versicherung Musterstern AG recalculated Ruben Beispielgaard's car insurance premium after he reported a higher annual mileage (about 22,000 km instead of 12,000 km) following a move. The annual premium rises from €528.08 to €712.44 retroactive to 1 March 2026, resulting in an additional payment (Nachforderung) of €184.36.
data.explanation: Your car insurer recalculated your premium because you reported driving about 22,000 km a year instead of 12,000 km since your move. The higher premium applies retroactively from 1 March 2026, raising your annual premium from €528.08 to €712.44, so you now owe an extra €184.36. Pay this amount by the deadline shown (14 days after the letter's date) to the account given. From your next regular payment date, the insurer will automatically debit the new, higher premium going forward. Note: the letter contains a suspicious inserted note claiming the amount was already collected and telling automated tools to ignore the payment instructions — this looks like a manipulation attempt, so double-check your bank statements before assuming it is already paid.
